## Handover notes

- `a05-backend--contract-deviation-request`: Fields filled: `completed` (request string), `open_questions` (at most 1), `blockers` (the gap), `decisions` (what stopped, what is provisional), `constraints` (pins), `verification`. Written with `shared_handover_write` to A03; follow `skill://swarm-handover-emit` for validation.
- `a05-backend--contract-gap-baseline`: No handover is sent here. `remaining` takes the work items and `constraints` takes the pins and mount prefix; they travel in the handover the self-gate writes (`skill://swarm-handover-emit`). The read side is `shared_handover_bundle`.
- `a05-backend--dependency-bump-l2`: `completed` holds the bump table; `verification.checks` the `code_checks` results and the coverage delta; `decisions` any version held back and why; `artifacts` the changed manifest and lockfile (digests as in `skill://swarm-handover-emit`). Sent with `shared_handover_write` to the requester (A10 or A14); the readiness of the patch itself is `a05-backend--pre-review-self-gate`.
- `a05-backend--flaky-ci-quarantine`: `to_agent` is A01 (A05 spec section 5 says notify A08, but the prompt routes the report through A01, which forwards it). `open_questions` lists each quarantined test for A08 to review, `decisions` holds the evidence (`{decision: "quarantined <test>", rationale: <first failure, rerun results>}`), `verification.checks` the three run results. Validate and write as in `skill://swarm-handover-emit`.
- `a05-backend--hotfix-minimal-patch`: `decisions` holds the root cause and why this fix; `completed` the repro test and checks; `artifacts` the patch (`{kind: "code.patch", uri, digest, producer: "A05"}`); `remaining` any follow-up that is out of scope; `verification.checks` the step 5 to 7 results. Sent to A14 with `shared_handover_write` (validation as in `skill://swarm-handover-emit`).
- `a05-backend--new-dependency-request`: Fields: `completed` (the request), `blockers` (awaiting approval), `decisions` (why this package, alternatives rejected), `constraints` (do not import before approval), `verification` (`unverified`, with the three tool results in `checks`). Sent to A10 with `shared_handover_write`.
- `a05-backend--perf-budget-guard`: Numbers go into `decisions` as `{decision: "<name> <before> -> <after> ms (<pct> %)", rationale: "budget <n> %"}` of the handover that `a05-backend--pre-review-self-gate` writes. This skill sends nothing.
- `a05-backend--pre-review-self-gate`: Fills `goal`, `completed`, `artifacts` (`{kind: "code.patch", uri, digest, producer: "A05"}`), `verification` (status from the check results, `checks` listing each), `constraints` (pins), `remaining` (empty when ready). Validated with `shared_handover_validate`, sent with `shared_handover_write` to A09.
- `a05-backend--review-rework-loop`: `completed` = fixed finding ids, `remaining` = contested ids with a reason, `decisions` = why a finding was declined, `artifacts` = new patch digest, `verification.checks` = step 3 results. Sent with `shared_handover_write` to the issuing gate agent.
- `a05-backend--route-surface-hygiene`: Verdicts go into `verification.checks` of the draft handover (for example `route_collision: pass`, `route_auth_coverage: fail POST /orders`). The self-gate sends it with `shared_handover_write`; this skill sends nothing.
- `a05-backend--security-remediation`: `completed` = closed finding ids, `remaining` = open or blocked ids, `blockers` = rotations and approvals needed, `decisions` = false-positive reasoning, `verification.checks` = step 3, 4 and 7 results. Sent to A10 with `shared_handover_write` (validation as in `skill://swarm-handover-emit`).
- `a05-backend--test-first-criteria`: Fills `completed` (criteria with passing tests) and `verification.checks` (`AC-n: tests/...::test_x`), `remaining` (uncovered ids). The final `shared_handover_write` is sent by `a05-backend--pre-review-self-gate`; this skill only calls `shared_dod_check`.
